seo.description_zh: 了解我們的合作夥伴與供應商，提供歐洲優質 MFC 粒片板與裝飾板材。
seo.description_en: Learn about our partners and suppliers providing premium European MFC particleboard and decorative panels.

hero.subtitle_zh: 與歐洲品牌合作，提供優質產品
hero.subtitle_en: Partnering with World-Class Brands for Quality Products

introduction.subtitle_en: We partner with renowned European brands to ensure the highest quality decorative panel products.
content_en: Hauboard has established long-term stable partnerships with several top European panel manufacturers, ensuring product quality and supply stability.
Our suppliers all comply with international environmental standards, with products certified by FSC, CARB, and other international certifications.
Through partnerships with quality suppliers, we can offer customers diverse product choices to meet different design needs.

items.name_zh: 歐洲 MFC 板材供應商
items.description_zh: 提供高品質的塑合板，具有優異的耐用性與美觀性
items.description_en: Providing high-quality MDF and particleboard with excellent durability and aesthetics.
features_zh: 符合中華民國國家標準（CNS） F1 甲醛釋出標準
多樣化表面壓紋可供選擇
防潮、防焰的優質板材性能
features_en: Complies with Taiwan CNS F1 formaldehyde emission standards
A variety of surface textures available

quality.subtitle_en: Our suppliers adhere to the highest quality standards
content_en: All products undergo rigorous quality testing to ensure compliance with international standards.
Regular product testing and quality audits to maintain consistent product quality.
Provide complete product certification documents and test reports.

story.subtitle_zh: 我們與供應商攜手共創的品質承諾
story.subtitle_en: Our commitment to quality through partnerships with suppliers

items.description_zh: Mauro Saviola擁有現代化的大型生產設備，每日可生產數千片高品質板材。專業的生產團隊與先進的自動化設備，確保每一片板材都符合嚴格的品質標準。
items.description_en: Our partners operate state-of-the-art large-scale production facilities capable of producing thousands of high-quality panels daily. Professional production teams and advanced automated equipment ensure every panel meets strict quality standards.

items.description_zh: 採用歐洲最先進的全自動化生產線，從原料處理到成品加工，全程電腦監控。精密的製程控制確保產品穩定性，大幅提升生產效率與品質一致性。
items.description_en: Utilizing Europe's most advanced fully automated production lines, from raw material processing to finished product manufacturing, all controlled by computer monitoring. Precise process control ensures product stability, significantly enhancing production efficiency and quality consistency.

items.description_zh: 每一片板材都經過嚴格的品質檢測流程，使用精密儀器測量厚度、密度與表面平整度。專業的品管團隊確保所有產品都符合國際標準，為客戶提供最可靠的品質保證。
items.description_en: Every panel undergoes rigorous quality testing procedures, with precision instruments measuring thickness, density, and surface flatness. Professional quality control teams ensure all products meet international standards, providing customers with the most reliable quality assurance.

items.description_zh: 擁有完整的物流配送系統與專業的運輸團隊，確保產品安全快速地送達全球各地客戶手中。
items.description_en: With a complete logistics distribution system and professional transportation team, ensuring products are delivered safely and quickly to customers worldwide.

items.description_zh: 積極參與世界各大國際建材與家具展覽會，展示最新的板材產品與技術創新。透過國際展會平台，與全球客戶交流，了解市場趨勢，持續提升產品競爭力與品牌知名度。
items.description_en: Actively participating in major international building materials and furniture exhibitions worldwide, showcasing the latest panel products and technological innovations. Through international exhibition platforms, we engage with global clients, understand market trends, and continuously enhance product competitiveness and brand recognition.

items.title_zh: FSC 森林管理委員會認證
items.description_zh: 確保木材來源符合永續森林管理標準
items.description_en: Ensures wood sources meet sustainable forest management standards.

items.title_zh: CARB 加州空氣資源委員會認證
items.title_en: CARB California Air Resources Board Certification
items.description_zh: 甲醛釋放量符合嚴格的環保標準
items.description_en: Formaldehyde emissions meet strict environmental standards.

items.description_zh: 產品符合歐盟安全、健康與環保要求
items.description_en: Products meet EU safety, health, and environmental requirements.

items.description_zh: 品質管理系統符合國際標準
items.description_en: Quality management systems comply with international standards.
